name: android_toggle_airplane_mode
description: Enables or disables device Airplane mode. Enabling it turns the radios off and drops a Wi-Fi ADB connection; only use over USB, or confirm first.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

enable.description: True to enable Airplane mode, false to disable.
